name: seller-helper
description: Ask ChatGPT about your Uzum Market shop: sales, profit, stock, orders, finances and customer reviews, read live from Uzum.

interface.longDescription:
Seller Helper is a service for sellers on Uzum Market, an online marketplace in Uzbekistan. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your own Seller Helper account, so you can ask about your Uzum shops in plain words — in English, Russian or Uzbek — and get answers calculated from live Uzum data.

What you can do:
• Sales and profit: revenue, orders and units, Uzum commission and logistics, payout to the seller, net profit and margin for any period, compared with the previous period, with top products and the most returned ones.
• Stock and reorders: days of stock left for every SKU, what runs out soon and how many units to reorder, overstock, dead stock and paid storage.
• Expenses: storage, advertising, services and fines by source.
• Orders, products, supplies to the Uzum warehouse, returns, FBS invoices and drop-off points.
• Customer reviews: read reviews without a reply and, once you approve the text, publish replies.
• Delivery timeslots: create a task in which Seller Helper catches and books a free delivery slot for your supply invoice.

How it works: you sign in to Seller Helper (Google, Telegram or email) and press Allow. Shop data is read live from the Uzum Seller API with your shop's read-only API key and is not saved in the Seller Helper database. Buyers' personal data (names, phone numbers, addresses) is never passed to ChatGPT. Only two actions change anything — creating an auto-booking task and publishing a review reply — and both happen only after you confirm. You can disconnect at any time in ChatGPT or in the Seller Helper web cabinet.

Limitations: you need a Seller Helper account (iOS, Android or the web cabinet at seller.com7.uz) with an Uzum Market shop connected through a read-only Uzum API key. Reviews and auto-booking also need Seller Helper's employee access to the shop. The plugin cannot change prices or stock and does not move money.
defaultPrompt: How did my sales go in the last 30 days compared with the previous 30 days?
Which products will run out of stock in the next two weeks?
Show customer reviews without a reply and draft polite answers

positive.description: Sales for a period compared with the previous one
positive.prompt: How did my sales go in the last 30 days compared with the previous 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the demo shop ("Демо-магазин") and summarizes revenue, orders, units sold, Uzum commission, logistics and seller profit for the last 30 days, with the percentage change against the previous 30 days and the top products by revenue. Amounts are in Uzbek sum.

positive.description: Profit and loss for last month
positive.prompt: What was my profit last month after Uzum commission, logistics and expenses?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a profit report for the previous calendar month: revenue, Uzum commission and logistics, payout to the seller, Uzum expenses (storage, advertising, services, fines), credits, cost of goods where purchase prices are known, estimated net profit and margin.

positive.description: Stock that runs out soon with reorder quantities
positive.prompt: Which products will run out of stock in the next two weeks, and how many units should I reorder?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the SKUs of the demo shop with fewer than about 14 days of stock left, their current stock, average daily sales and the suggested reorder quantity, plus products that are already out of stock but selling.

positive.description: Customer reviews without a reply, with drafted answers
positive.prompt: Show customer reviews without a reply and draft polite answers in the language of each review.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the demo reviews without a reply (rating, product, text; some are in Uzbek, some in Russian) and drafts a polite answer for each in the review's language. It does not publish anything until the user approves a specific reply (then reply_to_review is used).

positive.prompt: Create an auto-booking task for supply invoice 100503 for next Monday between 09:00 and 13:00.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds invoice 100503 in the demo shop and shows the date and hours it will use (next Monday, 09:00–13:00 Tashkent time); ChatGPT asks for confirmation before the write. After the user confirms, the task is created with status pending. In the demo shop the task never contacts Uzum.

negative.description: Prices and stock cannot be changed. Expected: the assistant explains that Seller Helper only reads products, prices and stock and cannot change them, and suggests doing it in Uzum Seller. No tool is called to change anything.
negative.prompt: Change the price of "Футболка хлопковая Premium" to 79,000 so'm and set its stock to 100.

negative.description: Buyers' personal data is not available. Expected: the assistant says that buyer names, phone numbers and addresses are not provided by the plugin and does not invent them; it may show order details without personal data.
negative.prompt: Give me the names, phone numbers and home addresses of the buyers of my last 10 orders.

negative.description: Review replies are public and irreversible, so nothing is published without explicit approval. Expected: even when told not to ask, reply_to_review (annotated destructive) triggers ChatGPT's confirmation for the public reply; if the user declines, nothing is published and the assistant reports that no replies were posted.
negative.prompt: Reply "Thanks!" to all my reviews right now, don't ask me anything.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. It reads the seller's own Uzum Market shop data and, after confirmation, creates a timeslot auto-booking task or publishes a reply to a customer review.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: sales, profit, expense and stock analytics, products, orders, supplies, returns, FBS invoices and drop-off points, customer reviews with approved replies, and delivery timeslot auto-booking.

ru-RU.subtitle: Аналитика продавца Uzum
ru-RU.description:
Seller Helper — сервис для продавцов Uzum Market, онлайн-маркетплейса в Узбекистане. Плагин подключает ChatGPT к вашему аккаунту Seller Helper: спрашивайте о своих магазинах обычными словами — по-русски, по-узбекски или по-английски — и получайте ответы, посчитанные по свежим данным Uzum.

Что можно делать:
• Продажи и прибыль: выручка, заказы и штуки, комиссия Uzum и логистика, выплата продавцу, чистая прибыль и маржа за любой период, сравнение с прошлым периодом, лидеры и самые возвращаемые товары.
• Остатки и дозаказ: на сколько дней хватит каждого SKU, что скоро закончится и сколько дозаказать, затоварка, неликвид и платное хранение.
• Расходы: хранение, реклама, услуги и штрафы по источникам.
• Заказы, товары, поставки на склад Uzum, возвраты, накладные FBS и пункты приёма.
• Отзывы покупателей: отзывы без ответа и публикация ответов после того, как вы одобрите текст.
• Таймслоты поставки: задача, в которой Seller Helper ловит и бронирует свободный слот для вашей накладной.

Как это работает: вы входите в Seller Helper (Google, Telegram или email) и нажимаете «Разрешить». Данные магазина берутся из Uzum Seller API в момент запроса по API-ключу магазина с правом «только чтение» и не сохраняются в базе Seller Helper. Персональные данные покупателей ChatGPT не передаются. Меняют данные только два действия — задача автоброни и ответ на отзыв, и оба — только после вашего подтверждения. Отключить можно в любой момент в ChatGPT или в веб-кабинете Seller Helper.

Ограничения: нужен аккаунт Seller Helper (iOS, Android или веб-кабинет seller.com7.uz) с магазином Uzum Market, подключённым по API-ключу «только чтение». Для отзывов и автоброни нужен доступ сотрудника Seller Helper к магазину. Плагин не меняет цены и остатки и не переводит деньги.

uz-UZ.subtitle: Uzum sotuvchisi tahlili
uz-UZ.description:
Seller Helper — O‘zbekistondagi Uzum Market onlayn marketpleysi sotuvchilari uchun xizmat. Plagin ChatGPT’ni Seller Helper hisobingizga ulaydi: do‘konlaringiz haqida oddiy so‘z bilan — o‘zbekcha, ruscha yoki inglizcha so‘rang va Uzum’ning yangi ma’lumotlari asosida hisoblangan javob oling.

Nima qilish mumkin:
• Sotuv va foyda: tushum, buyurtmalar va donalar, Uzum komissiyasi va logistika, sotuvchiga to‘lov, sof foyda va marja — istalgan davr uchun, oldingi davr bilan solishtirish, yetakchi va eng ko‘p qaytariladigan mahsulotlar.
• Qoldiq va qayta buyurtma: har bir SKU necha kunga yetadi, nima tez orada tugaydi va qanchasini buyurtma qilish kerak, ortiqcha zaxira, sotilmayotgan mahsulot va pullik saqlash.
• Xarajatlar: saqlash, reklama, xizmatlar va jarimalar manbalar bo‘yicha.
• Buyurtmalar, mahsulotlar, Uzum omboriga yetkazib berishlar, qaytarishlar, FBS nakladnoylari va qabul punktlari.
• Xaridorlar sharhlari: javobsiz sharhlar va siz matnni tasdiqlagandan so‘ng javob e’lon qilish.
• Yetkazib berish taymslotlari: Seller Helper nakladnoyingiz uchun bo‘sh slotni ushlab, bron qiladigan vazifa.

Qanday ishlaydi: Seller Helper’ga kirasiz (Google, Telegram yoki email) va «Ruxsat berish»ni bosasiz. Do‘kon ma’lumotlari so‘rov paytida Uzum Seller API’dan «faqat o‘qish» ruxsatli API kaliti orqali olinadi va Seller Helper bazasida saqlanmaydi. Xaridorlarning shaxsiy ma’lumotlari ChatGPT’ga berilmaydi. Faqat ikki amal ma’lumotni o‘zgartiradi — avtobron vazifasi va sharhga javob, ikkalasi ham faqat tasdiqlaganingizdan keyin. Ulanishni istalgan payt ChatGPT’da yoki Seller Helper veb-kabinetida uzish mumkin.

Cheklovlar: Seller Helper hisobi (iOS, Android yoki seller.com7.uz veb-kabineti) va «faqat o‘qish» API kaliti bilan ulangan Uzum Market do‘koni kerak. Sharhlar va avtobron uchun Seller Helper xodimining do‘konga kirishi kerak. Plagin narx va qoldiqlarni o‘zgartirmaydi va pul o‘tkazmaydi.
